access: Class-separation premise stated directly in terms of the defining time classes. No priority or originating-paper attribution is asserted.
conventions: The complete bit length controls the exponent. An arbitrary FPT factor in a parameter need not be quasipolynomial in L.
definition: There is a language in NP outside deterministic quasipolynomial time.
model: Deterministic worst-case decision time on complete binary inputs of length L.
name: NP ⊈ QP
quantifiers: QP is the union over fixed c ≥ 1 of DTIME(2^O((log(L+2))^c)). Containment would allow a language-specific algorithm and exponent.
